status: Parameterized candidate specification; release review, resolved participant environments and future adapters are not claimed complete.
priority_formula: 4*outcome_impact + 3*wrong_answer_consequence + 2*cross_journey_reuse; ordinal planning judgments, not a measured demand index; delivery readiness is separate.

phases.title: Qualify the measurement system
phases.purpose: No participant performance results are released before trustworthy fixtures, independent references, evaluators, provenance and failure accounting exist.

phases.title: Publish the first bounded CPU workflow study
phases.purpose: Implement and evaluate the 24 specified local/offline instances. Report task/cohort outcomes, not a universal SDK rank.

phases.title: Expand scientific and computing-model coverage
phases.purpose: Advance approximation/noise/applications and independently eligible QEC, pulse, analog, photonic, annealing, mixed-dimensional and measurement-based lanes.

phases.title: Measure useful capacity and operational scaling
phases.purpose: Add matched-device accelerators, independent-work parallelism, state/tensor partitioning and restart studies with real resource telemetry.

phases.title: Validate controlled live workflows and external replication
phases.purpose: Add separately authorized acquisition, prospective model validation, drift-aware repetition and independently reproduced public evidence.

workflows.title: Reuse a parameterized experiment
workflows.user_outcome: A researcher evaluates a reusable experiment at seven parameter bindings and obtains all requested local moments, without leaking a previous binding or state.

workflows.title: Run an adaptive measurement protocol
workflows.user_outcome: An experimenter needs classical feed-forward, bounded stopping and reset semantics to survive execution and result mapping.

workflows.title: Route an algorithm to legal connectivity
workflows.user_outcome: A device user needs a legal compiled program and correctly reconstructed logical outputs, with compile latency and interaction cost exposed.

workflows.title: Evaluate a many-term observable
workflows.user_outcome: A scientist needs every requested expectation and their weighted total at controlled numerical error, including nonlocal and complex-phase-sensitive terms.

workflows.title: Differentiate a shared-parameter model
workflows.user_outcome: An optimizer needs a trustworthy multi-output Jacobian with repeated parameter occurrences before it can rely on learning results.

workflows.title: Train a hybrid regression model
workflows.user_outcome: A practitioner needs correct minibatch gradients across the quantum/classical boundary and a reproducible training trajectory under a complete evaluation budget.

workflows.title: Predict physical dynamics observables
workflows.user_outcome: A many-body researcher needs observable predictions for a fixed Hamiltonian and physical time, with software and discretization errors distinguished.

workflows.title: Sample an asymmetric measurement distribution
workflows.user_outcome: A user needs correctly mapped counts whose distribution is equivalent to the requested measurement law, not merely a total shot count.

workflows.title: Recover work without duplicate submission
workflows.user_outcome: An experimenter needs to reconcile interrupted work without silently losing records or duplicating paid execution.

workflows.title: Round-trip an executable program
workflows.user_outcome: An integration engineer needs another tool or environment to preserve program, register and adaptive semantics through interchange.

acceptance.rule: Every requested finite scalar must satisfy abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference); no dropped outputs.

instances.reference: Closed-form graph-state local moments; dense Kronecker validation at n=4.
instances.required_negative: Swap one binding, drop a repeated binding update, or change a Y sign.
instances.measurements: complete seven-binding latency;binding/setup split;peak host memory;all-output maximum error

acceptance.confidence_rule: upper_TV = empirical_TV + sqrt((K*ln(2)+ln(190/0.01))/(2*N)) + 1e-10; accept each decision only if upper_TV <= 0.04; N=65536; K=8 teleport or 12 reset-loop. All 190 decisions across 18+1 contexts and ten blocks must pass; unused allocation is not recycled.

instances.reference: Teleportation identity for every joint branch; independent dense branch-projection density audit for six input states.
instances.required_negative: Remove conditional Z, remove conditional X, swap m0/m1, or omit a measured branch.
instances.measurements: protocol completion;all-context distribution discrepancy;complete context acquisition time;logical shot/branch accounting

acceptance.confidence_rule: upper_TV = empirical_TV + sqrt((K*ln(2)+ln(190/0.01))/(2*N)) + 1e-10; accept each decision only if upper_TV <= 0.04; N=65536; K=8 teleport or 12 reset-loop. All 190 decisions across 18+1 contexts and ten blocks must pass; unused allocation is not recycled.

instances.reference: Bounded geometric stopping law with exact reset postcondition and all twelve record categories.
instances.required_negative: Fail to reset after success, ignore the third-try cutoff, or drop unsuccessful records.
instances.measurements: protocol completion;all-context distribution discrepancy;complete context acquisition time;logical shot/branch accounting

acceptance.target: full CZ and arbitrary one-qubit unitaries on listed undirected edges; no ancillas
acceptance.final_layout: allowed only with explicit logical reconstruction
acceptance.verification: n=6: full operator up to one global phase; n=8,12: three complete output probe states up to one global phase per probe; probe checks are not a universal equivalence proof
acceptance.primary_quality: number of physical full CZ interactions; report compile-time/interaction-count Pareto points; no scalar winner

execution_profile.smt: Do not share the measured physical core with an active sibling; record the actual SMT policy.
execution_profile.host_identity: The same physical host and immutable image for every stack in a cohort; exact CPU model/OS/kernel/BIOS, clocks and dependencies must be sealed in the run manifest before any participant timing.
execution_profile.process_memory_limit: Per-case cap, maximum 16 GiB including SDK-owned child processes.
execution_profile.stochastic_seed_rule: Take first 8 bytes of SHA256("sdkbench-first-wave:0.1-candidate-1:<instance>:<block>:<context>") modulo 2**32; block is 0..9; context is 0-based fixture order. Same integers requested of participants, not the same RNG stream.

references.environment: Reference generation uses NumPy only; record exact environment in artifacts.json. No participant module is imported.
references.validation: Analytic anchors, separate small dense construction, five-point derivatives, density/branch identities, exact event tables and product-formula-vs-physics checks.
